page_note: Page divides cleanly into two halves: segments 0-19 are substrate teaching enumerating the cosmic Origins (Father of Life, Five Sons, Origin of Architects/Great Builder, Omophoroi-upholder, Origin of Releasers, Origin of Wisdoms/Virgin of Light, Mind of Light as awakener-of-sleepers and gatherer-to-recognition). Segments 20-23 are an editorial chapter heading introducing Kephalaion 12, framing the next teaching polemically as 'the five sayings uttered in deviance in the cosmos.' Segments 24-25 contain a clear apostolic-dialogue seam ('Ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ' bridge + 'Pronounce to us, our Lord'). Segments 26-37 expound the doctrine of the Baptists / Pure Ones (ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲓⲟⲥ) — polemical reportage of a rival sect's teaching on names. Editorial fatigue score (+1.63 with apostolic_dialogue 0→6.5) confirms structural seam at the chapter boundary.
